labels.text: This task was asked to stop.

S35.18.needs: A signed-in AGI Cloud account and a research run that has not yet finished.
S35.18.note: The extension stop control is generic to any cloud task; no research-specific control was found in the extension. The 'recorded as cancelled' part is in apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/research-loop.ts (persists 'interrupted' and emits state 'cancelled' with summary 'Research was cancelled.'), which the tester cannot see directly. The Stop action is hidden once the run is settled, and I did not confirm that a research run appears in the Cloud tasks list.
steps: Sign in to AGI Cloud if asked, then run the command Code: Show Cloud Tasks from the Command Palette.
Select the research task row in the Cloud tasks list while it is still running (not finished, failed or stopped).
In the task detail list, scroll to the Actions section and select Stop this task.
In the modal dialog that asks Stop "<task title>"?, click Stop this task.
Look for the notice This task was asked to stop. Then refresh the list and check the task shows as stopped (state label stopped), with the work done so far kept in the conversation.
S35.18.where: Code: Show Cloud Tasks > select the research task in the Cloud tasks list > Actions > $(stop-circle) Stop this task > Stop this task (modal confirmation)
